scientific_integrity: Two standalone deterministic programs use different finite-field square tests; all finite steps are exhaustive, with explicit bounded scope.
scientific_limitations: Finite exhaustive classification only for the zero-diagonal open-neighborhood system on F_49, with explicit affine semilinear group. Other field orders, other query conventions, historical priority and external verification are not covered.
title: The complete Paley-49 shattering polynomial and two free orbits of extremal supports
